candidates.verbatim_passage: For several other counties, heat wave definitions were tied to specific temperatures (examples: "in the 90s"; "98°F day and 89°F night for a 18-hr period"; "3 consecutive days over 101°F"); other definitions accounted for air moisture either explicitly or through the use of heat index as a trigger ("temperatures above 95°F with humidity above 50%"; "heat index above 115°F").
